{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {len(duplicates)}")

# Show the sample_seq values for duplicates
print("\nSample_seq values for duplicate patients:")
duplicates[['patient_id', 'sample_seq']].sort_values(by='patient_id').head(10)"}
